text:
mara: Quick sync — drafting a roadmap slice for console observability we should decide: per-route cost heatmap, pluggable trace hooks with sampling control, error analytics (grouping + causal hints), and dashboard templates for customer teams. TL;DR: want to ship minimal surface for Oct alpha, canary in Nov. Thoughts?

jin: +1 on per-route cost heatmap. how do we attribute costs to routes vs shared model tokens? need a mapping for batching/kv cache.

samir: For trace hooks: agree on pluggable hooks but sampling matters. If we start with deterministic sampling rules (by route + error + user-id hash) we can keep overhead low. memory impact biggest risk.

olivia: UX ask — dashboard templates should include an "investigate" view: top traces, cost spike timeline, error waterfall. keep it 2-click to open traces from a span.

mara: @jin good call — propose attribution model: token-cost attribution by request-ids, plus heuristics for shared batches (pro-rate by prefix length). we'll document tradeoffs in RFC.

leo: ops/rollout plan idea: alpha = internal + 2 pilot customers; canary = 5% traffic on Redwood Dedicated, failover to coarse metrics if trace store overloaded.

jin: Acceptance criteria I care about: (1) per-route cost within 5% of billing baseline, (2) trace ingest increases <10% CPU on runtime, (3) error analytics can group regressions across models.

samir: sample config prototype:
```
trace_sampling:
  - rule: "errors"
    rate: 1.0
  - rule: "route::high_cost"
    rate: 0.2
  - rule: "default"
    rate: 0.01
```
we can convert to hash-based sampling in runtime.

mara: customer asks: AcmeHealth needs per-org cost breakout and PCI-friendly traces (redaction). FinServ wants slower retention but full trace linkability. we'll surface config flags for retention/PII redaction.

olivia: UI note — surface redaction status inline and show sampled rate per view. hide raw payloads by default.

samir: Also adding: tracing hooks need feature flags to disable per-tenant. Ops should be able to throttle trace ingestion per-tenant.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled for branch obs/trace-hooks on 2024-06-12 09:30 UTC :rocket:

mara: Action items: 1) Jin to write cost attribution proposal (RFC) by Tue; 2) Samir prototype sampling + per-tenant throttle; 3) Olivia -> dashboard mock by next Wed; 4) I'll assemble launch criteria with SLAs and canary plan. sync Thurs 10am. Anyone object?

jin: lgtm

olivia: lgtm :+1:

samir: ok, will start prototyping today.
